instruction: I don't want Thunderbird to automatically mark messages as read when I preview them. Please turn off this auto-read feature.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to disable automatic marking of messages as read when previewed in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks that the preference 'mailnews.mark_message_read.auto' is set to false in the prefs.js file. This maintains similar complexity to the original task, focusing on mail reading behavior preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: disabling Thunderbird's auto-read feature by checking mailnews.mark_message_read.auto preference
Data flow is semantically correct: get_vm_file retrieves prefs.js file path, check_thunderbird_prefs parses the file and validates the preference value
Expected value is accurate: mailnews.mark_message_read.auto set to false is the correct Thunderbird preference for this feature
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is written to disk before verification
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter as rules dict (rule.get('expect', {})), following the framework's type='rule' pattern
Null handling is correct: metric returns 0.0 when result is None (file retrieval failure)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Static type warning (Union return type from get_vm_file) is not a runtime issue since multi=False by default and None is handled, but could be clarified in documentation

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
